Q: Why can a healthy container be an unsafe candidate for production traffic?
spoken: A process health check does not establish business correctness, data/schema compatibility, permission safety or acceptable quality. Promote an immutable artifact only after the relevant gates and recovery checks. Use readiness, liveness and rollout status for their distinct operational roles, and preserve a known compatible rollback path.
